note: Adapted from the original description of Holmgren 1913 (German, published as Hamitermes (Globitermes) globosus forma depilis n. f.), of the rank of form (forma), treated here as a subspecies following the catalogue. The original is in German, extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan, with a few misrecognised words and figures (e.g. l,i for 1,1), checked against the context; measurements in mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Almost entirely identical with G. globosus; the posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum, however, broadly but not deeply concave, the mesonotum concave more deeply than the metanotum; many weak brown veins between the radial sector and the media; the size usually the same as in globosus, but the antennae longer.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: As in G. globosus, but the head without setae, the pronotum without long setae, and the abdominal pilosity far sparser and shorter.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: very deeply pigmented, even between the sternites and the tergites. Distribution: Borneo. Distinguishable from G. globosus only in the pilosity (head and pronotum without setae, abdominal pilosity thin and short) and in the wing venation (many weak veins between Rs and M).
